sources.cite: Microsoft Learn, Azure Network Watcher: Next hop overview (last updated 2026-02-25)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: next hop gives the 'Next hop type, IP address, and Route table ID of a specific destination IP address'; types include VirtualAppliance, Internet and None; 'If the route is defined using a user-defined route, next hop returns the route table that has the route. Otherwise, it returns System Route'; routes that send traffic to 'a network virtual appliance can lead to connectivity issues'. That a user route overrides the system default route is from the Virtual network traffic routing page, seen only as a search result on 2026-11-17 (to verify).
